slides.headline: 6 THINGS AI DOES THAT SHOULD BE ILLEGAL
1) AUDIT ANY CONTRACT IN 60 SECONDS
slides.body: Lawyers charge $350 an hour to do this. "Here is a contract I'm about to sign. List every clause that could cost me money or limit my rights, in plain English"

slides.headline: 2) CLONE YOUR EXACT WRITING VOICE
slides.body: A ghostwriter charges $100 an hour to learn your voice. "Here are 5 emails I wrote. Study my tone and word choices. Now write this reply in my voice: [paste]"

slides.headline: 3) STEAL YOUR COMPETITOR'S PLAYBOOK
slides.body: Consultants charge $10,000 to map your competitor's strategy. "Here is my competitor's website [paste it]. Find their pricing, target customer, and weak spots. Tell me exactly how to beat them"

slides.headline: 4) PREDICT WHAT YOUR CUSTOMER BUYS NEXT
slides.body: Data analysts charge $80 an hour for this. "Here are my last 50 customer orders. Find the buying pattern. Tell me which customers will reorder next and the best week to reach out"

slides.headline: 5) SOUND LIKE A 10-PERSON TEAM
slides.body: Agencies charge $5,000 for proposals like this. "Write a proposal for [client]. Include market analysis, three options with timelines, and projected profits. Make it so detailed nobody guesses one person wrote it"

slides.headline: 6) NEGOTIATE ANY PRICE DOWN
slides.body: Negotiation coaches charge $300 an hour. "I want to buy [item] for less than [price]. Write 3 scripts: one that starts low, one that uses silence, one where I walk away"

slides.headline: SAVE THIS FOR WHEN YOU NEED IT
slides.body: You'll want these prompts the next time you sign a contract, write a proposal, or negotiate a deal. Save this post. Daily AI news and real skills right here

caption:
Swipe to see 6 AI tricks that feel like having a cheat code for your career and business 🃏

Audit any contract for hidden traps in 60 seconds, clone your exact writing voice so nobody can tell, steal a competitor's full strategy from their website, predict what your customers will buy before they know themselves, make your business sound like a 10-person team with one prompt, negotiate any price down with three ready-made scripts.

A year ago every one of these took a $200/hour consultant. Now they take 30 seconds and a prompt. The gap between people who know these and people who don't gets wider every week.
